useCase: Review task messages and extract the action for a local message parser.

fields.name: message
fields.description: A task message to parse and review.

scenarios.name: Extract a task
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Show inspect pump as the extracted task.

scenarios.name: Missing message

scenarios.name: Unsupported format
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Reject the unsupported message without inventing a task.

limitations: Invented examples for the local integration fixture; operational formats are unverified.
